newsitem.title: ANTIGUA AND BARBUDA: Cricket-Benjamin ruled out by stress fracture.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Benjamin ruled out by stress fracture.

text.p: West Indies paceman Kenneth Benjamin is doubtful for the test series against India in the Caribbean starting next week because of a stress fracture.

Benjamin, who recently returned from New York where he saw sports-injury specialist Dr Ainsworth Allen, has been told by the Jamaica-born doctor that a rib stress fracture will keep him out of action for up to six weeks.

The Antiguan bowler, who came home early from West Indies recent tour of Australia nursing what was reported then as a side strain, aggravated the injury in a Red Stripe Cup match against Trinided and Tobago.

Benjamin told the Caribbean News Agency (CANA) that while Dr Allen had noted the injury had started to heal, he also advised that he should limit his exercise programme to swimming and cycling for four to six weeks.
The first test in the five-match series against India starts in Kingston, Jamaica, on March 6.
